summary: Verified RBAC (backend + frontend) and Auto-GPS lifecycle (backend + frontend). Employee cannot access companies/employees/create-tasks (all 403), and task GET is filtered by assigned_to (server ignores client-supplied assigned_to for employees; detail/update on unassigned task -> 404). Admin retains full access. Attendance check-in auto-starts a GPS session (notes: 'Auto-started with attendance check-in'), check-out ends it, and repeat check-in is idempotent. Frontend: employee sidebar shows exactly the 7 expected items; admin sidebar shows the 10 expected items; TasksPage renders 'My Tasks' for employee with no create-task-button; AttendancePage shows 'My Attendance', check-in triggers geolocation + 'GPS Tracking Active' banner + auto-GPS toast.
critical_code_review_comments: attendance.py: check-in returns 400 'Already checked in today' if any attendance record exists for today, even after check-out. This blocks a same-day second check-in (and consequently a fresh GPS session). Consider allowing new check-in after a completed check-out, or expose an admin reset. Not part of the current AC but worth noting for real-world use.
gps.py stop_auto_gps_session: does not compute total_distance/duration when auto-ending. Sessions ended via check-out therefore always show total_distance=0.
tasks.py POST/PUT: employee filtering uses user['_id'] (string form) - works because create paths store created_by/assigned_to as strings. Ensure consistency if any legacy tasks store ObjectId there.
seed_data_creation: For deterministic auto-GPS test, admin's today attendance + active gps_sessions are wiped via direct MongoDB access inside the test (TestAutoGPS._reset_state). Also manually reset employee's today attendance once during Playwright run to exercise the check-in flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-GPS test wipes today's attendance for admin user via pymongo to bypass the 'Already checked in today' constraint. Playwright confirmed 'GPS Tracking Active' banner appears on employee check-in with geolocation granted (12.9716, 77.5946). Frontend routes are under /dashboard/* (not /tasks or /attendance at root). All AC items in the review request pass.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found for this review scope.
